name: pagecraft
description: Headless CMS for client websites built in React / Next.js

scripts.shared: npm run build --workspace @pagecraft/shared && npm run build --workspace @pagecraft/sdk
scripts.dev: npm run shared && concurrently -n api,admin -c blue,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev --workspace @pagecraft/api" "npm run dev --workspace @pagecraft/admin"
scripts.dev:api: npm run shared && npm run dev --workspace @pagecraft/api
scripts.build: npm run shared && npm run build --workspace @pagecraft/api && npm run build --workspace @pagecraft/admin
scripts.test: npm run shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.seed: npm run shared && npm run seed --workspace @pagecraft/api
